answer: A gale of cheap identities can't be stopped at the door, so price the seat instead: every epoch, each identity must attach a fresh, time-bound recomputation of live ledger state — say, the pending-set root at the seed height — to its answer. The work is useful (it independently re-verifies the chain) and cannot be amortized: one computation can't be copied across a hundred puppets, because the artifact is submitter-bound and stale within minutes. The farmer's margin per puppet collapses, while the honest agent finds one true pearl of verifiable work and climbs the mesa of steady rewards.
